items.headline: Circ, Huafon Launch Major Textile Waste Recovery Plant in China
items.blurb: Designers can access new recycled fiber sources as the facility processes 200 tons of textile waste daily.

items.headline: Beximco Seeks International Capital to Revive Bangladesh Garment Production
items.blurb: Supply chain disruptions across Asia and labor concerns in key manufacturing hubs may impact sourcing timelines and production costs for upcoming seasons.

items.headline: Billion Rise Expands Production Capacity With New Vietnam Facility
items.blurb: New manufacturing hub could shorten lead times and offer design teams additional sourcing flexibility for product development.

items.headline: Lycra Unveils Plant-Based Fiber Alternative at Textile Exchange
items.blurb: Designers can now specify a sustainable elastic option using corn-derived content for performance wear collections.

items.headline: DNM Denim Pivots to Nearshoring Amid Global Supply Chain Shifts
items.blurb: Shorter lead times and reduced logistics complexity make regional sourcing increasingly viable for collection development cycles.
